events.title: Zoo Lights
events.ageLabel: All ages. Kids 2 and under are free
events.schedule: Select nights Nov 23 to Jan 3. Sun–Thu 4:30–9pm, Fri–Sat 4:30–10pm
events.priceLabel: Adults $29.95, youth $22.95, less on value nights. Free 2 and under

registration.note: Public tickets go on sale Thu Nov 5 at 9am. Members got early access starting Nov 2 and save 10%. Closed Thanksgiving and Christmas.

events.description: The zoo's 35th season of holiday lights, on select nights from late November through Jan 3.
events.sourceNote: denverzoo.org Zoo Lights 35 page: 'November 23-January 3' select nights, Sun-Thu 4:30-9pm, Fri-Sat 4:30-10pm, closed Thanksgiving and Christmas. Adults and seniors $29.95, youth $22.95, youth 2 and under free. Value nights $25.95 adult and $18.95 youth. Members $26.95 adult and $20.65 youth (10% off). Member priority from Nov 2, tickets 'released to the public on Nov 5 at 9:00 a.m.' No year printed on the dates, but the page is the 35th season, copyright 2026, and Nov 2 (Mon) and Nov 5 (Thu) match 2026. Only the first date of the range is listed as a session because the specific select nights are on the ticket calendar.

events.title: Zoo Lights Sensory-Friendly Night
events.ageLabel: All ages. Kids 2 and under are free
events.priceLabel: Adults $25.95, youth $18.95. Free for kids 2 and under

registration.note: Tickets go on sale to the public Thu Nov 5 at 9am. Members can buy from Nov 2 and save 10%.

events.description: A calmer Zoo Lights night with no strobing, more light around campus and low-volume music, including on the carousel and train. Crowds are smaller.
events.sourceNote: denverzoo.org sensory-friendly night page: 'December 31', 4:30-9:00pm, adults and seniors $25.95, youth $18.95, kids two and under free, members 10% off ($23.35 and $17.05), on sale Nov 5 with member priority Nov 2 and a banner saying public release Nov 5 at 9:00am. No strobing, increased light, low-volume music including the Conservation Carousel and Denver Zoo Railroad, reduced crowds, aimed at guests with sensory processing disorders. The page shows no year, so 2026 is taken from the current Zoo Lights 35 on-sale dates.

events.ageLabel: All ages. Kids 2 and under are free

events.description: Holiday lights fill the York Street gardens every evening of the season. Arrive within 30 minutes of the time on the ticket.
events.sourceNote: botanicgardens.org Blossoms of Light page and Winter/Holiday Events page: Nov 20-Jan 10, 4:30-9pm (grounds cleared 9:45pm), closed Nov 26 and Dec 25. Adult $19-$45, member $16-$38, free for children 2 and younger, plan-ahead pricing by date and time, membership does not guarantee a ticket. Presales at 10am: Wed Nov 4 (President's Circle through Gardens Plus), Thu Nov 5 (Friends & Family), Fri Nov 6 (Dual Plus, Individual Plus). Public Mon Nov 9 at 10am, queue opens 9:30am. Years not printed, but the weekdays match 2026 and the footer is 2026. Strollers can be checked out first come, first served. Sessions list the first 10 open nights.
